summary: Frontend-only testing completed for the new Notifications push diagnostics panel using code review plus unauthenticated mobile-web runtime checks. Diagnostics card renders expected fields, retry tap is non-crashing, and notifications screen baseline interactions still work.

ui_bugs.issue: On 375px mobile viewport, the Retry button is partially clipped at the right edge of the diagnostics card.

integration_issues.flow: Manual retry from diagnostics card in web preview
integration_issues.issue: Tapping retry logs 'Push registration is not ready to retry yet.' because retry handler is null in web shim; UI does not reflect this in last-error row.
Initial navigation hit a transient load timeout before successful render, consistent with prior tunnel flakiness.

issues: Diagnostics header row overflows on narrow mobile width; action button alignment needs responsive handling.

action_items: Prevent retry action when no retry handler is available (disable/hide button) or write failure reason into diagnostics store so Last error reflects the tap outcome.
Adjust diagnostics header layout for small widths (e.g., wrapping/stacking title and retry control) to avoid clipping.
Run authenticated native-device validation to confirm real registration status transitions and token/backend registration behavior.
critical_code_review_comments: Notifications diagnostics rows are correctly bound to shared push diagnostics store fields (auth session, convex auth/loading, projectId, permission, device, token, status, last registered, last error).
Retry wiring is safe from crash perspective: retry callback is wrapped in try/catch and local loading state resets in finally.
Web shim usePushNotifications.web.ts is a no-op, so diagnostics live updates and retry handler setup are unavailable in web preview by design.
context_for_next_testing_agent: This run used unauthenticated web preview only (per constraints). Card and rows were validated via testIDs. Retry tap produced console warning about missing retry handler. Native authenticated retest is required for true push registration path.
rca_of_issue: Primary gap is environment-path mismatch: diagnostics retry expects a handler from native push hook, but web shim intentionally does not register one, producing predictable 'not ready' errors on retry taps. UI clipping is caused by diagnostics header row layout with right-side action on narrow width. MOCKED APIs: NONE.
